messages:
riley (pm): Heads-up — CloudPayments asked for a geo-phased A/B of the new pricing hint UI. Needs tenant-isolated flag, two variants (concise vs rich), regional canaries (EU/NA), per-tenant token cap, silent low-cost fallback, and audit exports to their GCS path. Named on-call for first 48h.

jess (eng): Proposal: feature flag `ui.pricing.hints.v2` with modes: off/control/concise/rich. For CloudPayments we'll set override->concise at 1% then step to 5%/20% per region if stable. Fallback mode `hints.v2-lite` uses cached embeddings and smaller context.

omar (sre): Circuit-breaker + token budget needed. Canary window: 90m with 5m buckets. Monitors: p95 latency, error_rate(5xx), token_burn/min, and conversion delta. Auto-fallback triggers: error_rate >= 0.5% for 3 buckets OR p95 > 1400ms for 3 buckets OR token_burn > budget * 1.25 for 2 buckets -> switch tenant to `hints.v2-lite`.

maria (sales): CloudPayments legal wants audit export and a visible admin toggle. Also they asked for a named SRE contact for 48h. I'll provide GCS KMS ARN and schedule pre-launch.

lee (data): A/B metrics: conversion, downstream billing validation, average tokens per session, and CTR on hints. Bucketed by tenant/region/variant. We'll compute uplift and 95% CI. Golden prompts: run 30 representative prompts every 15m across variants to detect quality drift.

jess (eng): Draft flag YAML: 
```yaml
flag: ui.pricing.hints.v2
default: off
derived_modes: [control, concise, rich]
overrides:
  - tenant: "cloudpayments"
    mode: concise
rollout:
  - region: eu
    pct: 1
  - region: na
    pct: 1
fallback: hints.v2-lite
audit_export: gs://cloudpayments-exports/pricing-hints/
```

omar (sre): Telemetry: tag traces `canary=pricing_hints_v2` and emit per-tenant CSV hourly to their GCS with `flag_state` and `model_variant`. Add webhook to `#ops-cloudpayments` on auto-fallback. Also add debug shadowing for ops-only: duplicate responses to internal pipeline with `billing=off`.

maria (sales): I'll confirm GCS path and KMS ARN: they provided `projects/cloudpayments/locations/global/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/cp-key-01`. Also scheduling pre-launch review for 2026-11-02.

lee (data): Go/no-go gates after initial 90m: conversion uplift >= +1.5% OR no regression beyond -0.6%, p95 delta <= +175ms, token delta <= +12%. If any gate fails -> immediate rollback to control + postmortem. We'll also monitor holdback cohort.

jess (eng): Dev tasks: 1) flag + routing rule PR; 2) hints.v2-lite runtime config PR; 3) telemetry + audit export PR. I'll split into PRs and aim to link by 2026-11-01.

omar (sre): Ops tasks: token budget enforcer, circuit-breaker + alerts, webhook to customer channel, and runbook. I'll draft playbook and incident steps.

runbot: pipeline queued: `pricing-hints-v2/canary` -> smoke -> golden-eval -> scheduled prod canary 2026-11-05 09:00 UTC

maria (sales): Action items recap for CloudPayments: Jess eng for PRs, Omar SRE for runbook and alerts, Lee data for metric hooks, Maria sales for legal & contact. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your PRs/links are posted.

jess (eng): :white_check_mark: will open PRs today.

omar (sre): :white_check_mark: drafting runbook now.

maria (sales): I'll confirm KMS and send calendar invite.

riley (pm): Thanks team — closing once PR links and runbook are attached here.
